events.text: HMCS Warrior was recommissioned as HMS Warrior.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was recommissioned as HMS Warrior on 23 March 1948

events.text: Trials of the flexible deck had lasted since November 1948.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The trials have lasted since November 1948

events.text: Warrior departed on the first mission to carry troops and aircraft to the Far East.
events.subject: self
events.quote: departing in August on the first such mission

events.text: Warrior sailed to Cyprus in response to a crisis in the Middle East.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June 1951 , with 16 Parachute Brigade embarked , Warrior sailed to Cyprus

events.text: The ship underwent refit at Devonport Dockyard.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The ship underwent refit during most of 1952 and 1953 at Devonport Dockyard

events.text: The refit at Devonport Dockyard ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The ship underwent refit during most of 1952 and 1953 at Devonport Dockyard

events.text: Warrior was deployed to the Far East, patrolling off the coast of Korea.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During 1954 Warrior was deployed to the Far East

events.text: The ship was sent to evacuate refugees from Haiphong to Vung Tau.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September the ship was among those sent to evacuate non-Communist refugees from Haiphong

events.text: Another refit was carried out at Devonport.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After returning to England another refit was carried out in 1955 at Devonport

events.subject: self
events.quote: the Royal Navy decommissioned Warrior in February 1958
